messages:
elaine (marketing): quick heads-up — we want to announce the Optimize v2 release next Tue 9AM PT. Can eng confirm changelog PR + docs links will be ready by EOD Fri? :calendar:
raj (eng): working on changelog now, PR #842 will be up by tomorrow morning. Broke down changes in the PR body. pinging @brooke for docs readiness.
brooke (docs): thanks — I have a draft guide and API snippets. need final model perf numbers for the benchmark callout. will post links here when live.
sophie (growth): webinar signup is scheduled for Wed 10AM PT. if we have benchmarks, we'll include a slide and a short blurb in the invite. can marketing confirm headline copy?
mason (product): rollout plan idea: staged canary with three waves (5%, 25%, 100%) over ~2 hours. need a feature flag and a rollback command. also want to capture token-cost delta for the post.
raj (eng): yes, we have a canary flag. I'll attach the rollout script here:
```
./scripts/rollout --flag optimize_v2 --waves 5,25,100 --wait 10m
```
raj (eng): deploy-bot — schedule canary deploy morning of Tue at 08:00 PT, CI should run beforehand. ETA ~30m.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for optimize_v2 on Tue 08:00 PT — CI checks pending. :gear:
elaine (marketing): perfect. brooke can you paste the final docs link + changelog PR here by EOD Fri so I can bake into the release post, webinar assets, and the benchmark narrative? :pray:
brooke (docs): will do. current draft doc (internal): https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize-v2-draft — will replace with final public URL. changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/842
raj (eng): added perf summary to the PR: "~25% median latency reduction, ~12% token cost decrease vs v1" — full bench report (internal) will be uploaded to GCS and linked in the PR later today.
sophie (growth): awesome — once brooke drops final links I'll update the webinar landing page and set email copy. do we want a short benchmark GIF for socials and the landing page? :camera_with_flash:
mason (product): yes, include a 15s GIF showing latency improvement on the dev UI and a one-liner for the hero. also confirm if there are any breaking changes.
elaine (marketing): last ask: please add an explicit "breaking changes" bullet in the changelog PR (even if it's a no-op). legal and support need that to sign off before publish.
raj (eng): noted — no public API breaking changes. internal config keys changed but not user-facing. I'll add a clear "No breaking changes" line to the PR and tag @support for verification.
brooke (docs): will add final links + webinar blurb by 17:00 PT Fri. I'll also generate a short copy variant for social posts.
elaine (marketing): thanks! I'll draft the announcement post and share for review Mon afternoon. tagging @sophie @mason for final copy approval. :rocket:
